A second fresh private configuration has no plugin and genuine Compose version fails. System fallback directories were absent.
The actual RunDoctor API reports compose_check_failed and unavailable for that genuine absence; profile and client checks pass.
A third fresh private configuration with the same verified plugin passes discovery against the same admitted engine identity.

independentReview.scope: Peer checked the bound runner changes only INPUT, all genuine executable/plugin/API-harness/policy hashes, all nine original joined jobs and eighteen raw capture hashes, all three actual Doctor reports and unchanged source maps. No probe or engine query was repeated.

limitations: This uses three separate fresh private configurations, not a durable same-target recovery sequence.
The executable harness calls the actual exported Go API. It is not an installed frontend doctor command; no such public command is claimed.
Detached installed hosts deliberately do not inherit DOCKER_CONFIG. This does not prove their missing-Compose startup or persistent-data recovery.
The stage code remains cause-unconfirmed in production. This fixture's independent absence evidence does not change that contract.
Actual installed failure scenarios and final unchanged committed candidate qualification remain required.
